b01_apply_aspect.title: apply runs the main process of an aspect from asp/ and waits (D-066)

b01_test1.title: variation 1 of b01: the same aspect, called in a loop with a computed argument (D-133)

b02_apply_output.title: an aspect gives results back through @ output parameters (D-048, D-066)

b02_test1.title: variation 1 of b02: results used as inputs, in a loop (D-133)

b03_apply_state.title: each apply creates a new state of the aspect: a second call sees nothing of the first (D-066)

b03_test1.title: variation 1 of b03: three applies, three fresh states (D-133)

b04_apply_named_args.title: apply with arguments by position, by name and with a default value (D-028, D-066)

b04_test1.title: variation 1 of b04: every argument by name, in another order (D-133)

b05_apply_spread.title: spreading a list into positional arguments and a map into named arguments (D-072 i)

b05_test1.title: variation 1 of b05: spread of a whole list and of a whole map (D-133)

b06_aspect_error.title: an error not recovered in the aspect is raised in the driver at the apply line (D-072 d)

b06_test1.title: variation 1 of b06: the error code of the aspect is the code of the raise (D-133)

b07_aspect_over.title: over in an aspect ends the aspect; the driver goes on after apply (D-072 d)

b07_test1.title: variation 1 of b07: over in the aspect twice: the driver goes on each time (D-133)

b08_aspect_panic.title: panic in an aspect ends the whole application with exit code 1 (D-072 d)

b08_test1.title: variation 1 of b08: panic ends the application: the finalize of the driver does not run (D-133)

b09_log_files.title: log_err and log_wrn write log files in the output folder out/ (D-057, D-114)

b10_aspect_function.title: a function declared in an aspect is used by its main (D-066, D-100)

b10_test1.title: variation 1 of b10: the function of the aspect with its default and by name (D-133)

b11_aspect_procedure.title: a procedure of an aspect changes an aspect-level variable; the driver's own variable is not touched (D-066, D-100)

b11_test1.title: variation 1 of b11: the state of the aspect is new in every call (D-133)

b12_aspect_fresh_state.title: main and the procedures of an aspect share its variables, and every apply starts them again (D-066)

b12_test1.title: variation 1 of b12: the list of the aspect is new in every call, in a loop (D-133)

b13_aspect_missing.title: apply of an aspect that has no file is an error before the run (D-112)

b14_aspect_too_many_args.title: more positional arguments than parameters is a check-time error (D-112)

b14_test1.title: variation 1 of b14: the right call: two arguments, then one (D-133)

b15_aspect_apply_aspect.title: an aspect can't apply another aspect: compile error (D-066)

b16_aspect_recover.title: an aspect recovers its own error: the driver never sees it (D-020, D-072)

b16_test1.title: variation 1 of b16: the aspect recovers its own error, twice (D-133)

b17_aspect_trace.title: an error nobody recovers: the error first, then the frames in order of call (D-113)

b18_lambda.title: a lambda is an anonymous function: called at once, passed as an argument, held by a function type (D-109)

b19_closure.title: a closure keeps the state of the function that made it; every apply makes new closures (D-101, D-109)

b20_aspect_unknown_param.title: an argument named like no parameter is a check-time error (D-112)

b20_test1.title: variation 1 of b20: the right name of the optional parameter (D-133)

b21_aspect_missing_arg.title: a missing mandatory argument is a check-time error (D-112)

b21_test1.title: variation 1 of b21: the mandatory argument by name (D-133)

b22_aspect_wrong_type.title: an argument of the wrong type is a check-time error (D-112)

b23_aspect_default_exclusive.title: an aspect without a kind word is exclusive (D-130)

b24_aspect_second_process.title: an aspect has one process and it is named main (D-066)

b25_aspect_driver_variable.title: an aspect can't read a variable of the driver (D-072)

b26_aspect_finalize.title: finalize of an aspect runs when main ends, also by over; then the driver goes on (D-063, D-072)

b26_test1.title: variation 1 of b26: finalize in a loop, by return and by over (D-133)

b27_aspect_concurrent.title: a concurrent aspect can also be applied, one call after the other (D-090)

b27_test1.title: variation 1 of b27: a concurrent aspect applied with other texts (D-133)

b28_aspect_folder.title: apply with a folder: the aspect is searched there first, then in asp/ and in the root (D-112)

b28_test1.title: variation 1 of b28: only the aspect of the default folder (D-133)

b29_aspect_output_named.title: an @ output parameter that follows optional parameters is named at the call (D-106)

b29_test1.title: variation 1 of b29: the default exponent, then both by name (D-133)

b30_function.title: functions: result, named arguments, default values, several results (D-028, D-070, D-086, D-087)

b31_procedure.title: procedures: no result, side effects, @ passes by reference, no @ passes a copy (D-048, D-086, D-100)

b32_recursion.title: a function can call itself: Fibonacci (from demo/fibonacci.eve, D-099)

b33_function_without_result.title: a function must have a result: a subprogram without result is declared with procedure (D-100)

b34_procedure_bang.title: a procedure is made for side effects and is never deterministic: it never ends with ! (D-101)

b35_exit_procedure.title: exit in a procedure leaves only the procedure; the process goes on (D-111)

b36_over_procedure.title: over in a procedure ends the whole process, not only the procedure (D-111)

b37_param_order.title: a mandatory parameter may follow optional ones, and the call then names it (D-106)

b38_named_required.title: a parameter after optional parameters can't be positional: the call must name it (D-106)

b39_vararg_function.title: a vararg collects the rest of the arguments; an optional parameter after it is named (D-029)

b40_procedure_in_expression.title: a procedure has no value: it can't be used in an expression (D-100)

b41_variant_params.title: a variant type holds one of the listed types and takes the type of the value assigned (from demo/variant_type.eve and demo/variant_params.eve, D-099)

b42_defer_procedure.title: defer in a procedure runs when the procedure ends, by any path, in reverse order (D-081)

b43_vararg_procedure.title: a vararg parameter collects the arguments of a procedure; * spreads a list into it (D-029, D-040)
